Thread-local scratch state and frame tracking variables.

# Purpose
This file defines thread-local storage for the scratch allocator state used by `fd_scratch`. It declares per-thread variables that track the scratch memory range, the current free and stop positions, and the active frame stack state. The comments show the expected initial values at thread start, which makes the file a set of global thread-local configuration and state variables rather than executable logic. When `FD_HAS_ALLOCA` is enabled, it also declares a thread-local size check used with `alloca` support.
